levels.description: Move north of the map; weakens Head of Sui if all enemies in the area are defeated, lowering Sui's ATK and reducing the range of Head of Sui's [Wrath of Eons]
Move south of the map; weakens Tail of Sui if all enemies in the area are defeated, lowering Sui's HP and reducing the range of Tail of Sui's [Order Overturned]
Move west of the map; weakens Left Claw of Sui if all enemies in the area are defeated, lowering Sui's RES and Left Claw of Sui will no longer use [Hidden Moon]
Move east of the map; weakens Right Claw of Sui if all enemies in the area are defeated, lowering Sui's DEF and Right Claw of Sui will no longer use [Shrouded Sun]
Retreats all Operators and resets redeployment timers; Face Sui
